cases.title: Successfully add a student with valid name and grade
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid student name and a grade within the inclusive range of 0 to 100, then clicking the 'Add Student' button, successfully adds the entry to the student list in the 'Name: Grade' format, assigns a unique data-id attribute, and resets the form inputs.

cases.title: Successfully add students at boundary grades (0 and 100)
cases.description: Verify that students can be successfully added when entering boundary grade values of 0 and 100, appending them correctly to the student list with proper formatting and resetting the form fields.

cases.title: Prevent submission for invalid grades outside 0-100 range
cases.description: Verify that entering a grade below 0 or above 100 blocks form submission, displays an error message indicating the valid range, does not add any item to the student list, and retains the entered values in the input fields.

cases.title: Prevent submission when student name is empty
cases.description: Verify that attempting to submit the form with an empty 'Student Name' field blocks submission, adds no entry to the student list, and maintains validation integrity.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases completely cover the requirements, including normal operation, boundary values, error ranges for grades, and empty name validation. The scenarios are distinct, testable, and properly aligned with the provided requirements and data-testid attributes.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_49-R-1 defines the Student Grade Book interface with required inputs 'student-name' and 'student-grade', submit button 'add-student-button', and list 'student-list' with unique data-id attributes. It sets normal paths for valid addition and form reset, boundaries for grades 0-100, and abnormal paths for out-of-range grades displaying an error and retaining input values. Requirement e2edev_bench_49-R-2 specifies form validation rules for non-empty names and numeric grades within 0-100, blocking submission on violation, formatting list items as 'Name: Grade', using 'student-item-{index}' for data-id, resetting 'student-form', and handling boundaries (0, 100) and invalid values (<0, >100). Requirement e2edev_bench_49-R-5 reinforces the addition workflow, clearing inputs on success, retaining values on invalid grades, and consistent use of data-testid attributes. Gaps: Specific error message text is not explicitly defined. Actionable conditions: Valid name + grade [0-100] -> list append, format 'Name: Grade', unique ID, form reset. Invalid name/grade (<0, >100, empty) -> block submission, show error for range, retain inputs, no list update.
